svg.aria-label: Each row contains four chains with 4,000 retained draws each; proposal steps are 0.7 above and 0.03 below. Traces display every fifth draw while ESS uses every retained draw. Middle: lag autocorrelation. Right: histograms with the analytic Beta posterior.
